subchannels.name: Celestial Alternation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sun, moon, day, and night succeed one another as illumination advances and covering returns.
subchannels.active_motifs: solar disc and light `ش م س:B001/m01`; forenoon interval `ض ح و:B001/m01`; moon and moonlight `ق م ر:B001/m01`; full-moon night `س و ي:B012/m01`; bodily or ranked following `ت ل و:B001/m01`; bright day `ن ه ر:B002/m01`; daylight disclosure `ج ل و:B007/m01`; night darkness `ل ي ل:B001/m01`; covering veil `غ ش و:B001/m01`

subchannels.name: Dawn as Aperture and Breath
subchannels.scene_or_process: Darkness or constriction opens into dawn, widened space, and an outward breath.
subchannels.active_motifs: dawn breaking from night `ف ج ر:B002/m01`; broad fissure and water-burst `ف ج ر:B001/m01`; opening and widening `ن ه ر:B003/m01`; dawn breathing outward `ن ف س:B009/m01`; public emergence into sunlight `ض ح و:B002/m01`; disclosure after concealment `ج ل و:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Dawn is rendered as an aperture: light, space, water, and breath all move outward from confinement. The scene turns temporal emergence into a physical process of splitting, widening, and exhalation.

subchannels.name: Polishing, Glare, and Visible Marking
subchannels.scene_or_process: A surface is brightened until it becomes conspicuous, while excessive whiteness can overwhelm sight.
subchannels.active_motifs: polishing and visual clarification `ج ل و:B002/m01`; exposed forehead `ج ل و:B005/m01`; clear white day `ج ل و:B007/m01`; forenoon radiance `ض ح و:B005/m01`; pale or white coloration `ق م ر:B002/m01`; snow-glare confusion `ق م ر:B005/m01`; white facial covering `غ ش و:B007/m01`; white head or face marking `غ ش ي:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Polishing and daylight make forms legible, and white markings make an animal immediately visible. At the limit, the same brightness reverses into snow glare and confused vision, so disclosure and perceptual loss occupy opposite ends of one luminous process.

subchannels.name: Veiling and Loss of Awareness
subchannels.scene_or_process: A covering descends over an object, a population, or consciousness itself.
subchannels.active_motifs: material or perceptual covering `غ ش و:B001/m01` and `غ ش ي:B001/m01`; all-enveloping affliction `غ ش و:B002/m01`; swoon or deathly obscuration `غ ش و:B005/m01`; loss of understanding `غ ش ي:B007/m01`; stealthy self-concealment `د س و:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The night’s covering expands into a general mechanism of occlusion. Cloth, disaster, fainting, and deliberate hiding each place a layer between a subject and visibility, awareness, or social notice.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A field becomes visible, bright, veiled, or perceptually inaccessible through recurring changes of light and covering.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 91:1-4 moves from `الشمس` and `ضحاها` through the moon that `تلاها`, the day that `جلاها`, and the night that `يغشاها`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The cycle extends from celestial alternation into polishing, glare, white markings, enveloping calamity, and loss of awareness.

parent_channels.name: Formed Space and Vertical Order

subchannels.name: Cosmic Architecture
subchannels.scene_or_process: An overhead structure and a lower expanse are assembled, spread, and brought into finished form.
subchannels.active_motifs: building by joined components `ب ن ي:B001/m01`; sky or overhead canopy `س م و:B004/m01`; lower earth opposite the sky `ء ر ض:B001/m01`; spreading and extension `ط ح و:B001/m01`; straightened completed form `س و ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Building, spreading, and leveling form a single spatial operation. The sky supplies the raised canopy, the earth the extended lower field, and leveling the finishing action that gives the whole a coherent constitution.

subchannels.name: Level Expanse and Open Way
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ground is flattened into a broad, fair, traversable interval.
subchannels.active_motifs: wide smooth ground `س و ي:B009/m01`; fair middle or level place `س و ي:B006/m01`; earth-spreading `ط ح و:B001/m01`; spacious interval and distance `ن ف س:B015/m01`; gap between two sides `ع ق ر:B014/m01`; thick spread carpet `ء ر ض:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Flattening does more than enlarge the ground: it establishes a middle, a gap, and enough interval for passage or settlement. The carpet image miniaturizes the same operation as a portable plane laid out beneath occupants.

subchannels.name: Ascent, Ridge, and Summit
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler or visible figure rises from level ground through a pass toward a ridge or summit.
subchannels.active_motifs: rising and eminence `س م و:B001/m01`; high visible figure `س م و:B002/m01`; rising and settling above `س و ي:B003/m01`; elevated moon `ط ح و:B008/m01`; high rock `ط غ و:B006/m01`; smooth high slab `ط غ ي:B005/m01`; mountain summit `ن و ق:B001/m01`; climbable long ridges `ش ق و:B004/m01` and `ش ق ي:B004/m01`; steep mountain pass `ع ق ب:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Elevation is distributed across figure, motion, terrain, and endpoint. The pass and ridge make ascent a bodily route, while the summit, high slab, and raised celestial body make height a stable state of visibility and dominance.

subchannels.name: Structural Supports and Settlement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Posts, ribs, bases, and enclosing structures hold a dwelling or settled property in place.
subchannels.active_motifs: ribs and house posts `ب ن ي:B009/m01`; hide shelter `ب ن ي:B004/m01`; dwelling base or interior site `ع ق ر:B013/m01`; fortified refuge `ع ق ر:B015/m01`; landed property and household goods `ع ق ر:B016/m01`; staying and dwelling `ر ب ب:B007/m01`; earthbound staying `ء ر ض:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Support begins with load-bearing ribs and posts, expands into a shelter, and terminates in the base, refuge, and property of settlement. Bodily and architectural frames share the same function: they keep an inhabited structure upright and located.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Space becomes habitable or intelligible through construction, leveling, spreading, elevation, and stable support.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 91:5-7 names the sky that was `بناها`, the earth that was `طحاها`, and the self that was `سواها`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmic architecture continues into mountain ridges, smooth plains, house posts, hide shelters, and the base on which property and settlement stand.

parent_channels.name: Release, Flow, and Cultivation

subchannels.name: Rousing and Dispatch
subchannels.scene_or_process: A resting participant is stirred, directed, and sent toward a task or destination.
subchannels.active_motifs: rousing the still `ب ع ث:B001/m01`; setting out rapidly `ب ع ث:B004/m01`; release and dispatch `ر س ل:B001/m01`; successive movement `ت ل و:B001/m01`; hired carrier or cultivator `ف ل ح:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Rousing converts rest into directed motion, while dispatch gives that motion a destination and function. Following then turns a single departure into an ordered sequence of participants.

subchannels.name: Fissure, Channel, and Overflow
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pressure opens a fissure, water enters a channel, and excess rises beyond its bounds.
subchannels.active_motifs: broad opening and water eruption `ف ج ر:B001/m01`; river cutting the earth `ن ه ر:B001/m01`; widened opening `ن ه ر:B003/m01`; irrigation course `س ق ي:B003/m01`; water channels at valley ends `ذ ن ب:B004/m01`; surging overflow `ط غ و:B002/m01` and `ط غ ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The channel is a managed fissure: opening allows flow, a course directs it, and overflow marks the point at which directed movement escapes measure. Tail-like valley channels give the process a branching terminal geometry.

subchannels.name: Irrigated Ground and Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fertile ground is split, watered, covered by low growth, and brought into increase.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile productive soil `ء ر ض:B002/m01`; ploughing and soil-splitting `ف ل ح:B003/m01`; irrigation share `س ق ي:B003/m01`; prostrate ground-cover `ط ح و:B006/m01`; vegetal increase `ز ك و:B001/m01`; persistent green plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; tail-shaped plant `ذ ن ب:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Cultivation coordinates soil, incision, water allotment, and growth. The plants remain close to the earth or branch into tail-like forms, making agricultural increase a visible consequence of correctly guided flow.

subchannels.name: Breath and Relief from Constriction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Breath, space, or assistance opens a constricted condition and restores movement.
subchannels.active_motifs: outward breath `ن ف س:B001/m01`; relief of distress `ن ف س:B002/m01`; spaciousness and respite `ن ف س:B015/m01`; easy unforced movement `ر س ل:B003/m01`; familiar ease `ر س ل:B007/m01`; widening and opening `ط ح و:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Exhalation is the bodily form of release, while respite and familiarity are its social and emotional forms. Smooth movement and widening complete a shared passage from pressure into room, ease, and renewed motion.

subchannels.name: Rain Cloud and Overcast
subchannels.scene_or_process: Clouds gather overhead, carry heavy precipitation, obscure the sun, and feed the waters below.
subchannels.active_motifs: cloud and rain overhead `س م و:B004/m02`; layered rain cloud `ر ب ب:B008/m01`; heavy rain-bearing cloud `س ق ي:B007/m01`; cloud mass `ن ه ر:B008/m01`; cloud obscuring the sun `ع ق ر:B018/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The cloud scene connects elevation to hydrology. Vapor gathers into an overhead mass, darkens the luminous field, and releases the precipitation that replenishes channels, fields, and drinking supply.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Something confined or still is opened, sent outward, or guided through a channel into productive motion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the roots occur at 91:3 `النهار`, 91:6 `طحاها`, 91:8 `فجورها`, 91:12 `انبعث`, and 91:13 `رسول` and `سقياها`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same release mechanism joins dispatch, river incision, exhalation, relief from distress, and the opening of soil for cultivation.

parent_channels.name: Abundance, Nourishment, and Giving

subchannels.name: Water, Drink, and Milk
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water or milk is made available, drawn, drunk, and retained as a life-sustaining supply.
subchannels.active_motifs: giving drink `س ق ي:B001/m01`; establishing a water supply `س ق ي:B002/m01`; abundant fresh water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; water sustaining life `ن ف س:B008/m01`; draught or drinking interval `ن ف س:B006/m01`; continuous milk yield `ر س ل:B006/m01`; full water bucket `ذ ن ب:B007/m01`; ladle `ذ ن ب:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Provision forms a complete handling scene: a source is established, liquid is drawn with bucket and ladle, and the drinker receives sustaining water or milk. Continuity of supply, rather than a single sip, defines the channel.

subchannels.name: Food Building the Body
subchannels.scene_or_process: Ingestion becomes bodily substance, growth, and renewed strength.
subchannels.active_motifs: swallowing and consuming `ل ه م:B001/m01`; food building flesh `ب ن ي:B010/m01`; growth and fattening `ز ك و:B001/m01`; thick syrup or nutritive paste `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; giving drink `س ق ي:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The body is treated as something constructed by intake. Swallowing admits material, food and drink supply it, and growth registers the successful conversion of nourishment into flesh and strength.

subchannels.name: Multitude and Material Plenty
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water, pasture, livestock, troops, or people accumulate into a conspicuous mass.
subchannels.active_motifs: vast crowd or army `ط ح و:B005/m01`; great quantity and scale `ل ه م:B004/m01`; gathered multitudes `ر ب ب:B004/m01`; plentiful water or pasture `ق م ر:B008/m01`; successive herds `ر س ل:B005/m01`; sudden arriving multitude `ف ج ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Abundance is spatial before it is evaluative: a mass spreads, gathers, or arrives in waves. Water, pasture, animals, and people share the same image of quantity becoming large enough to shape the surrounding scene.

subchannels.name: Generosity and Benefaction
subchannels.scene_or_process: Internal largeness becomes willing giving, bounty, and public good repute.
subchannels.active_motifs: gushing generosity `ف ج ر:B005/m01`; generous sufficiency `ل ه م:B004/m02`; willing gift `ر س ل:B010/m02`; generous high spirit `ن ف س:B014/m02`; blessing or benefaction `ر ب ب:B016/m01`; good reputation `س م و:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Giving is pictured as overflow from an ample interior. Bounty moves outward with the force of a spring, sustains others, and returns socially as a good name carried beyond the giver.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A supply exceeds immediate need and becomes sustaining water, food, multitude, wealth, or voluntary benefaction.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the relevant roots appear at 91:3 `النهار`, 91:5 `السماء`, 91:8 `فجورها`, 91:9 `زكاها`, 91:13 `سقياها`, and 91:14 `ربهم`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Material plenty passes into abundant milk, a body built by food, large crowds, open-handed giving, and praise spreading among people.

parent_channels.name: Inner Formation and Moral Outcome

subchannels.name: Self, Life, and Inner Cognition
subchannels.scene_or_process: A living self possesses identity, awareness, intention, and an inward saying before outward action.
subchannels.active_motifs: living soul `ن ف س:B011/m01`; individual self `ن ف س:B012/m01`; cognitive discernment `ن ف س:B013/m01`; completed formation `س و ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The self is simultaneously life, identity, cognition, and intention. Formation gives this interior a coherent shape from which conduct can proceed.

subchannels.name: Purification, Protection, and Flourishing
subchannels.scene_or_process: The self is cleansed, guarded from harm, brought into rectitude, and carried toward success.
subchannels.active_motifs: purification and righteousness `ز ك و:B002/m01`; self-protective piety `و ق ي:B002/m01`; straightening and sound formation `س و ي:B002/m02`; nurture toward completion `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; success and survival `ف ل ح:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Purification is not merely removal of stain; it is a constructive regimen of guarding, straightening, and nurture. Its outcome is a self able to endure and flourish.

subchannels.name: Concealment, Corruption, and Failure
subchannels.scene_or_process: The self is buried from view, turned away from right order, and deprived of its sought outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: stealthy burial `د س و:B001/m01`; misguidance and corruption `د س و:B003/m01`; breach of moral bounds `ف ج ر:B004/m01`; failure and deprivation `خ ي ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Burial provides the governing image: what should be formed and purified is instead pushed down and obscured. Corruption redirects it, moral breach opens a path away from right order, and failure names the resulting deprivation.

subchannels.name: Deceptive Impulse and Divided Interior
subchannels.scene_or_process: An inner impulse conceals itself, fabricates a claim, and competes with reflective intention.
subchannels.active_motifs: deceitful self `ك ذ ب:B008/m01`; concealed inward impulse `د س و:B001/m01`; inwardly drawn saying `ق و ل:B006/m01`; inward intention `ن ف س:B013/m02`; desire for the precious `ن ف س:B010/m01`; protective restraint `و ق ي:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The interior is a contested space rather than a single voice. Desire and a concealed impulse generate a private account, while intention and restraint determine whether that account remains deceptive or is brought under moral protection.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: The inner person is formed through cognition, protection, purification, concealment, or corruption, and those operations issue in flourishing or failure.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 91:7-10 moves from the self that was `سواها` through `فجورها وتقواها` to the one who `زكاها` or `دساها`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Moral interiority is rendered through concrete acts of straightening, shielding, burying, breathing, and building.

parent_channels.name: Message, Speech, and Social Circulation

subchannels.name: Messenger and Utterance
subchannels.scene_or_process: A sender appoints a messenger who bears and voices a statement to an audience.
subchannels.active_motifs: dispatched envoy `ب ع ث:B002/m01`; messenger and carried message `ر س ل:B002/m01`; spoken utterance `ق و ل:B001/m01`; tongue as articulator `ق و ل:B002/m01`; authoritative speaker `ق و ل:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Dispatch establishes provenance, the messenger carries the communication, and utterance makes it public. The authoritative speaker motif gives the voiced message social force beyond its bare wording.

subchannels.name: Inner Saying and Belief
subchannels.scene_or_process: A saying is formed inwardly, aligned with intention, adopted as a belief, and then made available for utterance.
subchannels.active_motifs: inward saying `ق و ل:B012/m01`; inwardly drawn speech `ق و ل:B006/m01`; belief or doctrine `ق و ل:B013/m01`; inward intention `ن ف س:B013/m02`; spoken utterance `ق و ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Speech begins before sound as an inwardly held conception. Intention gives the conception direction, belief fixes it as a position, and utterance carries it from private thought into an audible statement.

subchannels.name: False Attribution and Denial
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker fabricates words, assigns them to another, or discredits a truthful address.
subchannels.active_motifs: false report against another `ت ل و:B009/m01`; fabricated attribution `ق و ل:B005/m01`; falsehood `ك ذ ب:B001/m01`; imputing a lie `ك ذ ب:B002/m01`; deceptive embellished statement `ف ل ح:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Falsehood operates through attribution as well as content. A statement can be invented, placed in another’s mouth, used to discredit a messenger, or ornamented until its persuasive surface masks its invalidity.

subchannels.name: Directive Speech, Rebuke, and Objection
subchannels.scene_or_process: Speech binds an addressee, warns or rebukes, and then becomes subject to objection or rebuttal.
subchannels.active_motifs: idiomatic injunction `ك ذ ب:B003/m01`; imposed judgment `ق و ل:B010/m01`; authoritative negotiation `ق و ل:B009/m01`; warning through induced fear `خ و ف:B002/m01`; forceful rebuke `ن ه ر:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Directive discourse moves from command to enforcement: an authority states an obligation, warning gives it urgency, and rebuke confronts refusal. Negotiation then tests how the directive will operate between speakers.

subchannels.name: Rumor, Praise, and Reputation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated sayings circulate until they become a person’s public name or standing.
subchannels.active_motifs: circulating saying `ق و ل:B007/m01`; good repute `س م و:B008/m01`; fame that cannot be hidden `ج ل و:B006/m01`; loquacious speaker `ق و ل:B003/m01`; strength of character `ن ف س:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Speech leaves the immediate exchange and travels socially. Repetition makes a report widespread, loquacity increases its reach, and accumulated talk hardens into fame, praise, or moral reputation.

subchannels.name: Responsorial Voice and Performance
subchannels.scene_or_process: One voice calls or performs and another follows, accompanies, or answers it.
subchannels.active_motifs: answering voice after a singer `ت ل و:B007/m01`; paired performer or correspondent `ر س ل:B008/m01`; raised singing, reading, or lament `ع ق ر:B009/m01`; spoken articulation `ق و ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Sequence becomes audible as responsion: a leading sound is followed by a second voice, and paired performers sustain the exchange. Raised recitation, song, and lament give the scene a public, embodied acoustic form.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Meaning moves from inner conception through an authorized speaker into utterance, response, report, attribution, and public reputation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 91:11-14 joins communal denial with the messenger who `قال` and the people who `كذبوه`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Speech extends into private belief, negotiated judgment, musical responsion, rumor, and public reputation.

parent_channels.name: Sequence, Remainder, and Consequence

subchannels.name: Following, Procession, and Iteration
subchannels.scene_or_process: Participants move one after another, replace predecessors, or repeat a prior action.
subchannels.active_motifs: direct following `ت ل و:B001/m01`; successive groups `ر س ل:B005/m01`; succession and replacement `ع ق ب:B005/m01`; repeated return to an action `ع ق ب:B009/m01`; followers behind leaders `ذ ن ب:B003/m01`; rapid collective setting-out `ب ع ث:B004/m01`; immediate action without delay `ك ذ ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Sequence can be linear, substitutive, or iterative. A follower occupies the wake of another, successive groups preserve the line, and repetition turns one passage into a recurring cycle.

subchannels.name: Heel, Tail, Trace, and Remainder
subchannels.scene_or_process: The rear of a moving body becomes the place where traces and remnants persist.
subchannels.active_motifs: heel and footprint `ع ق ب:B002/m01`; tail or terminal rear `ذ ن ب:B002/m02`; remaining portion `ت ل و:B003/m01`; residue and aftereffect `ع ق ب:B011/m01`; last or final part `ع ق ب:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Rear anatomy supplies a concrete model of aftermath. Heel and tail mark the path behind a body, while residue and remainder are what an event leaves in the same trailing position.

subchannels.name: Retreat, Desertion, and Interrupted Motion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Forward movement is abandoned, reversed, or broken by a sudden halt.
subchannels.active_motifs: abandonment after companionship `ت ل و:B005/m01`; turning back on the heel `ع ق ب:B003/m01`; failed charge or cowardly stop `ك ذ ب:B004/m01`; animal running then halting `ك ذ ب:B007/m01`; withholding after apparent availability `ش م س:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Each motif begins with an expected continuation and then violates it. Companion, attacker, animal, or provider withdraws from the established line, making reversal a social as well as kinetic break.

subchannels.name: Sin, Outcome, and Punishment
subchannels.scene_or_process: An offense is followed by its terminal result and punitive repayment.
subchannels.active_motifs: sin or culpable act `ذ ن ب:B001/m01`; allotted share of punishment `ذ ن ب:B006/m01`; consequence and final outcome `ع ق ب:B006/m01`; punishment after wrongdoing `ع ق ب:B007/m01`; annihilating retribution `د م د م:B001/m01`; fear of an expected harm `خ و ف:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Wrongdoing initiates a causal sequence whose last member is not arbitrary: consequence follows the offense as its allotted share. Punishment closes the sequence through total leveling, while fear anticipates that terminal outcome.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: What comes after may follow, replace, remain as a trace, reverse course, or arrive as the consequence of an act.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 91:2 has the moon that `تلاها`, 91:14 places destruction `بذنبهم`, and 91:15 names `عقباها`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Temporal order is embodied in heels and tails, then extended into residue, retreat, punishment, and repeated action.

parent_channels.name: Transgression, Contest, and Collective Force

subchannels.name: Rebellion and Boundary Crossing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A participant exceeds a rightful measure, rejects restraint, and becomes a source of misguidance.
subchannels.active_motifs: transgression beyond bounds `ط غ ي:B001/m01`; rebellious excess `ط غ و:B001/m01`; heads of misguidance `ط غ و:B003/m01` and `ط غ ي:B003/m01`; coercive tyrant `ط غ و:B004/m01`; moral breach `ف ج ر:B004/m01`; sacrilegious conflict `ف ج ر:B006/m01`; induced corruption `د س و:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Transgression is a failure of measure that becomes socially active. The rebel crosses a boundary, the head of misguidance redirects others, and the tyrant converts excess into coercive rule.

subchannels.name: Hostility and Confrontation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Antagonism is displayed, an opponent is confronted, and hostile pressure is sustained by words.
subchannels.active_motifs: manifest hostility `ش م س:B003/m01`; confronting or exposing oneself to another `ء ر ض:B007/m01`; filling a heart with enmity `س ق ي:B010/m01`; verbal rivalry and insult `ع ق ر:B011/m01`; blows laid on with whip or sword `غ ش و:B006/m01` and `غ ش ي:B006/m01`; harsh rebuke `ن ه ر:B004/m01`; abandonment of an ally `ت ل و:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Hostility moves from inward saturation to outward display. Confrontation exposes the adversaries to one another, verbal rivalry keeps the conflict active, and desertion changes the social alignment around it.

subchannels.name: Competition and Overcoming
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rivals test endurance, fear, prestige, or skill until one overcomes the other.
subchannels.active_motifs: contest in fear `خ و ف:B003/m01`; rivalry and boasting `س م و:B007/m01`; deceptive victory in play `ق م ر:B007/m02`; negotiated contest `ق و ل:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Competition measures relative capacity rather than absolute strength. Fear, prestige, strategy, and speech become different arenas in which one participant seeks to exceed another.

subchannels.name: Hardship, Endurance, and Overcoming
subchannels.scene_or_process: Participants enter a difficult struggle, endure its strain, and seek to outlast or overcome one another.
subchannels.active_motifs: wretched state `ش ق ي:B001/m01`; hardship and exertion `ش ق و:B002/m01` and `ش ق ي:B002/m01`; mutual struggle `ش ق ي:B003/m01`; overcoming in struggle `ش ق و:B003/m01`; difficult temperament `ش م س:B002/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Hardship supplies both the condition and the arena of contest. Endurance keeps a participant within the struggle, difficult temperament intensifies resistance, and overcoming names the point at which relative stamina becomes dominance.

subchannels.name: Crowd, Rush, and Jostling
subchannels.scene_or_process: A mass gathers, surges forward, pushes internally, and becomes audible as a collective force.
subchannels.active_motifs: rapid collective movement `ب ع ث:B004/m01`; sudden arrival of a multitude `ف ج ر:B003/m01`; mutual shoving `ط ح و:B004/m01`; crowd or army of great extent `ط ح و:B005/m01`; collective voice `ط غ و:B008/m01`; circulating public saying `ق و ل:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Collective force has spatial, kinetic, and acoustic phases. A crowd arrives, occupies breadth, presses against itself, and produces a voice or report proportionate to its scale.

subchannels.name: Seizure and Extirpation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sudden force snatches, crushes, or engulfs until the target is erased.
subchannels.active_motifs: total extirpation `د م د م:B001/m01`; sudden snatch `ن ه ر:B006/m01`; engulfing calamity `غ ش و:B002/m01`; devouring disaster `ل ه م:B005/m01`; overpowering punishment `ط غ و:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Destruction is not merely a final state but a mechanism of sudden enclosure and removal. Snatching initiates it, engulfment denies escape, and extirpation leaves no surviving differentiation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Force crosses a limit, confronts an opponent, competes for dominance, gathers collectively, and may culminate in destructive overpowering.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 91:8 names `فجورها`, 91:11 `طغواها`, 91:12 the rising of `أشقاها`, and 91:14 the collective denial, hamstringing, and destruction.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Moral rebellion shares a shape with hydraulic overflow, animal restiveness, boasting contests, crowd pressure, and sudden mass arrival.

parent_channels.name: Animal Movement and Wild Ecology

subchannels.name: Camel Handling and Riding
subchannels.scene_or_process: A resting camel is roused, tamed, equipped, and guided into an easy gait.
subchannels.active_motifs: rousing a resting camel `ب ع ث:B001/m01`; she-camel form `ن و ق:B002/m01`; taming and management `ن و ق:B004/m01`; easy gait `ر س ل:B003/m01`; riding pad `س و ي:B010/m01`; saddle covering `غ ش و:B001/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Management transforms a resting or difficult animal into a rideable participant. Taming governs behavior, pad and cover distribute the rider’s load, and easy gait is the successful outcome of equipment and handling.

subchannels.name: Restiveness, Hoof Protection, and Immobilization
subchannels.scene_or_process: A skittish animal resists mounting, guards an injured hoof, or becomes unable to move.
subchannels.active_motifs: restive animal `ش م س:B002/m01`; immobilizing saddle injury or shock `ع ق ر:B003/m01`; guarded hoof and slight lameness `و ق ي:B003/m01`; tail and hindpart `ذ ن ب:B002/m01`; heel tendon `ع ق ب:B001/m01`; non-wounding saddle `و ق ي:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Restiveness and pain are read through altered movement. The animal withholds its back, protects the hoof, or loses locomotion entirely; careful saddle design provides the counter-mechanism that prevents injury.

subchannels.name: Hamstringing and Bodily Wound
subchannels.scene_or_process: A leg or tendon is cut, the animal falls, and slaughter or lasting injury follows.
subchannels.active_motifs: cutting the legs of a mount `ع ق ر:B002/m01`; bodily wound `ع ق ر:B001/m01`; heel tendon `ع ق ب:B001/m01`; animal hindpart `ذ ن ب:B002/m01`; she-camel `ن و ق:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The act targets the animal’s locomotive structure. Hindpart, heel tendon, and cut legs form a precise injury scene in which disabling movement becomes the immediate path to the animal’s death.

subchannels.name: Moonlit Pursuit and Wild Herds
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hunters enter moonlight, scan for game, and pursue animals that run, halt, or move in herds.
subchannels.active_motifs: setting out to hunt `س م و:B006/m01`; moonlit hunting `ق م ر:B003/m01`; searching raised gaze `ج ل و:B008/m01`; ground-devouring run `ل ه م:B003/m01`; wild cattle herd `ر ب ب:B014/m01`; young wild ox `ط غ و:B009/m01`; game animal running then stopping `ك ذ ب:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Moonlight defines both opportunity and risk: it reveals game while affecting sight. The hunter scans, the herd moves, and the pursued animal’s run-and-halt pattern creates the moment on which capture depends.

subchannels.name: Raptors, Carrion, and Wetland Birds
subchannels.scene_or_process: Birds occupy distinct ecological roles around carrion, prey, reeds, and water.
subchannels.active_motifs: eagle or raptor `ع ق ب:B013/m01`; male partridge `ع ق ب:B014/m02`; vultures circling a kill `ط ح و:B003/m01`; shrike `و ق ي:B005/m01`; turtledove `ق م ر:B012/m01`; water-fed papyrus or cane `س ق ي:B008/m01`; abundant water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The bird class resolves into habitats and feeding roles rather than a bare taxonomy. Raptors and vultures occupy pursuit and carrion scenes, while shrike and turtledove connect to water-fed cane and the margins of a wet habitat.

subchannels.name: Feeding, Grazing, and Night Watch
subchannels.scene_or_process: Herds graze by day, receive a delayed evening feed, and may be watched or left unattended under moonlight.
subchannels.active_motifs: forenoon grazing `ض ح و:B003/m02`; delayed camel supper `ق م ر:B010/m01`; unattended livestock by moonlight `ق م ر:B011/m01`; moonlit insomnia `ق م ر:B009/m01`; night activity or travel `ل ي ل:B002/m01`; herd succession `ر س ل:B005/m01`; plentiful pasture `ق م ر:B008/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The herd’s day is organized by feeding intervals and visibility. Forenoon grazing, evening delay, and moonlit watch form a practical cycle in which pasture, timing, and human supervision regulate animal survival.

subchannels.name: Mounting, Dominance, and Category Reversal
subchannels.scene_or_process: A dominant animal mounts, a rider settles above a mount, and a proverb reverses the expected sexed category.
subchannels.active_motifs: stallion mounting the herd `س م و:B003/m01`; mounting and settling above `س و ي:B003/m02`; camel becoming like a she-camel in proverb `ن و ق:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Vertical position carries social force in the animal scene: the animal above dominates, while the rider above controls. The camel-to-she-camel proverb exposes the instability of that expected role by turning category itself into the reversal.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Animals are roused, ridden, restrained, injured, herded, hunted, fed, or located within a habitat structured by water and vegetation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 91:12-14 moves from `انبعث` to `ناقة الله وسقياها` and then `عقروها`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The she-camel scene opens into riding technology, restive temperament, moonlit hunting, wetland birds, herd succession, and nocturnal feeding routines.

parent_channels.name: Kinship, Development, and Marital Exchange

subchannels.name: Birth, Fosterage, and Descent
subchannels.scene_or_process: A child is born, follows the mother, is nurtured by a household, and continues a line of descent.
subchannels.active_motifs: birth and newborn `ن ف س:B005/m01`; young following its mother `ت ل و:B006/m01`; sonship and descent `ب ن ي:B007/m01`; small derivative offshoot `ب ن ي:B008/m01`; fostered child `ر ب ب:B005/m01`; caregiver or nurse `ر ب ب:B005/m02`; descendants `ع ق ب:B004/m01`; newborn or lactating animal `ر ب ب:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Birth begins a sequence of dependence and continuation. The young follows the mother, nurture incorporates it into a household, and descent carries that household forward beyond the present generation.

subchannels.name: Maturity, Infertility, and Final Offspring
subchannels.scene_or_process: Development reaches completion, fails to produce offspring, or ends with a last child that has no successor.
subchannels.active_motifs: completed youth and maturity `س و ي:B005/m01`; bodily constitution `ب ن ي:B002/m02`; infertility `ع ق ر:B004/m01`; last child or final instance `ع ق ر:B005/m01`; paired state `ز ك و:B005/m01`; placental birth-fluid `س ق ي:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene places successful maturation beside reproductive limit. A formed and paired body may generate descent, while infertility or a final child closes the line and turns completion into termination.

subchannels.name: Courtship, Unveiling, and Marital Compensation
subchannels.scene_or_process: A woman becomes available to suitors, enters marriage, is unveiled, and receives a gift or compensatory due.
subchannels.active_motifs: marriage and consummation `ب ن ي:B006/m01`; bridal unveiling `ج ل و:B003/m01`; bridal gift `ج ل و:B009/m01`; courted widow or divorcee `ر س ل:B009/m01`; intercourse `غ ش و:B004/m01` and `غ ش ي:B004/m01`; dower or sexual compensation `ع ق ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Courtship is a staged social transition. Availability opens negotiation, marriage changes household status, unveiling makes the bride publicly visible, and gift or compensation formalizes the exchange surrounding consummation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Persons enter households through birth, nurture, descent, courtship, marriage, or compensatory exchange.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the participating roots occur at 91:5 `بناها`, 91:7 `نفس`, 91:13 `رسول` and `ناقة`, 91:14 `عقروها`, and 91:15 `عقباها`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Genealogical following extends to fosterage and infertility, while unveiling and gifts turn visibility into a structured marital transition.

parent_channels.name: Authority, Worship, and Covenant

subchannels.name: Deity, Lordship, and Worship
subchannels.scene_or_process: A deity is worshiped and a lord owns, governs, nurtures, and completes what is under that authority.
subchannels.active_motifs: deity and worship `ء ل ه:B001/m01`; lordship and ownership `ر ب ب:B001/m01`; nurture and completion `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; sacred house `ب ن ي:B003/m01`; self-protective reverence `و ق ي:B002/m01`; false object of worship `ط غ ي:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Worship and lordship establish a vertical relation of allegiance, care, and command. Protective reverence is the subject’s posture within that relation, while the false object of worship presents its rival and distortion.

subchannels.name: Institutional Rank and Guidance
subchannels.scene_or_process: Differentiated office-holders interpret, navigate, or direct a group within religious, political, or maritime institutions.
subchannels.active_motifs: local chieftain or authoritative speaker `ق و ل:B004/m01`; religious scholar `ر ب ب:B003/m01`; captain or pilot `ر ب ب:B017/m01`; deacon `ش م س:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Scholar, chieftain, captain, and deacon differ by institution, but each occupies a guiding rank. Their authority rests in interpretation, direction, or stewardship within an organized group.

subchannels.name: Covenant, Obligation, and Judgment
subchannels.scene_or_process: Parties enter a binding relation whose terms can be enforced, contested, or answered by consequence.
subchannels.active_motifs: covenant and pledged protection `ر ب ب:B011/m01`; guarantee or attached right `ت ل و:B004/m01`; substitute or commercial guarantee `ع ق ب:B010/m01`; objection or rebuttal `ع ق ب:B008/m01`; punishment after offense `ع ق ب:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A covenant causes an obligation to follow its holder. Guarantee secures performance, objection tests the pledged term, and punishment supplies the enforcing consequence when the relation is violated.

subchannels.name: Invocation, Prayer, Sacrifice, and Imprecation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sacred address invokes the divine name, seeks rain or blessing, offers sacrifice, or calls down harm.
subchannels.active_motifs: divine name in invocation or oath `ء ل ه:B002/m01`; prayer for rain `س ق ي:B006/m01`; sacrificial animal `ض ح و:B004/m01`; spoken address `ق و ل:B001/m01`; imprecation `ع ق ر:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Ritual speech acts in opposite directions: it requests provision and blessing, dedicates a sacrifice, or utters a curse. The divine name anchors each act as an address with consequences beyond ordinary conversation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Legitimate or illegitimate authority establishes worship, differentiates ranks, binds parties, and enforces judgment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 91:13 names `رسول الله` and `ناقة الله`, while 91:14 places judgment with `ربهم`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Sacred authority extends lexically into scholars, local rulers, captains, deacons, treaties, prayer, sacrifice, and imprecation.

parent_channels.name: Protective Surfaces and Crafted Supports

subchannels.name: Leather Shelter and Carrying Containers
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hide is stretched or sewn into a shelter, cover, garment, or carrying vessel.
subchannels.active_motifs: portable hide cover or container `ب ن ي:B004/m02`; protective barrier `و ق ي:B001/m01`; protective or carrying leather bag `خ و ف:B006/m01`; skin container for lots or arrows `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; hide-conditioning paste `ر ب ب:B006/m02`; saddle covering `غ ش و:B001/m02`; hide waterskin `ق م ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A single material system serves dwelling, transport, storage, and bodily protection. Stretching hide creates an enclosing surface; folding and sewing it convert that surface into a portable container.

subchannels.name: Tensioned Supports and Riding Gear
subchannels.scene_or_process: Flexible material is tensioned or padded to transfer force without breaking the supported body or tool.
subchannels.active_motifs: bow adhering to its string `ب ن ي:B005/m01`; tendon used as bowstring or binding `ع ق ب:B001/m02`; riding pad `س و ي:B010/m01`; non-wounding saddle `و ق ي:B003/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: String, tendon, pad, and saddle all manage tension. Some store force for release, while others distribute weight and prevent injury; each works by maintaining a calibrated relation between flexible and rigid parts.

subchannels.name: Dye, Pattern, and Visible Surface
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth receives color or pattern until its surface communicates status, beauty, or a deceptive appearance.
subchannels.active_motifs: cloth infused with dye `س ق ي:B009/m01`; small dyeing measure `ن ف س:B007/m01`; patterned cloth whose appearance misleads `ك ذ ب:B009/m01`; red garment `ع ق ر:B019/m01`; necklace pendants `ش م س:B004/m01`; white coloration `ق م ر:B002/m01`; veil or covering surface `غ ش و:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Dye penetrates a textile, ornament is attached to it, and the finished surface alters how the object is read. The patterned cloth’s “false” appearance makes visual display a material counterpart to verbal misrepresentation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Material is configured as a cover, container, pad, string, or marked surface so that it can protect, carry, support, or display.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the roots occur at 91:4 `يغشاها`, 91:5 `بناها`, 91:7 `سواها`, 91:8 `تقواها`, 91:13 `رسول`, and 91:15 `عقباها`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Cosmic covering contracts into leather shelters and bags, while animal tendons, glued bows, dyed cloth, and deceptive patterns turn surfaces into tools and signs.

parent_channels.name: Deterioration, Affliction, and Cessation

subchannels.name: Ripening, Withering, and Crop Loss
subchannels.scene_or_process: Fruit begins to ripen, cold or cutting interrupts development, and plant tissue yellows or dries.
subchannels.active_motifs: fruit ripening from its tip `ذ ن ب:B005/m01`; dates spoiled by cold `ق م ر:B004/m01`; yellowing and drying plant `ع ق ب:B015/m01`; cut palm that withers `ع ق ر:B007/m01`; barren sand `ع ق ر:B017/m01`; productive plant growth `ز ك و:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Development is tracked from the fruit’s tip through maturity toward possible loss. Cold, cutting, or barren ground interrupts the growth sequence, converting ripening into yellowing, dryness, and sterility.

subchannels.name: Material Decay and Failed Supply
subchannels.scene_or_process: A container, wooden object, or recurring yield is corrupted until it no longer performs its function.
subchannels.active_motifs: termite consuming wood `ء ر ض:B010/m01`; moonlight-spoiled waterskin `ق م ر:B006/m01`; milk that disappears instead of continuing `ك ذ ب:B006/m01`; split or cut material `ف ل ح:B001/m01`; remnant after use `ع ق ب:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Functional failure is gradual but observable: wood is eaten, hide separates or spoils, and an expected milk flow ceases. Splitting exposes the damaged structure, while the remnant records what survives after use or decay.

subchannels.name: Symptoms, Disease, and Loss of Awareness
subchannels.scene_or_process: Bodily disturbance becomes visible as tremor, cold, suppuration, fear, internal disease, or unconsciousness.
subchannels.active_motifs: bodily tremor `ء ر ض:B008/m01`; cold or catarrh `ء ر ض:B009/m01`; suppurating lesion `ء ر ض:B011/m01`; derangement `ء ر ض:B012/m01`; harmful gaze `ن ف س:B003/m01`; visible fear `خ و ف:B005/m01`; cleft lip `ف ل ح:B002/m01`; internal disease `غ ش ي:B003/m01`; habitual intoxicant `ع ق ر:B012/m01`; scorpion sting `ع ق ر:B020/m01`; swoon `غ ش و:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Affliction is legible through altered movement, temperature, tissue, awareness, and expression. The progression moves from external symptom to internal seizure, ending when consciousness itself is covered.

subchannels.name: Breath, Blood, Last Gasp, and Consuming Death
subchannels.scene_or_process: Vital breath and blood sustain life until injury or devouring affliction brings the final gasp.
subchannels.active_motifs: breath leaving the body `ن ف س:B001/m01`; life-blood `ن ف س:B004/m01`; living soul `ن ف س:B011/m01`; last gasp `ت ل و:B008/m01`; body-affecting drug or substance `ع ق ر:B008/m01`; consuming fever, calamity, or death `ل ه م:B005/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Life is represented through moving breath and circulating blood. Injury or consuming affliction disrupts those motions, and the last gasp marks the narrow boundary at which the living self departs.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A living body, crop, container, or ongoing supply loses integrity, continuity, perception, or life.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the roots occur at 91:2 `القمر`, 91:4 `يغشاها`, 91:6 `الأرض`, 91:10 `خاب`, 91:11 and 91:14 forms of `كذب`, 91:13 `سقياها`, and 91:14 `عقروها`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Frosted dates, yellowing plants, termite-eaten wood, a spoiled waterskin, vanished milk, suppuration, and swoon all enact the same movement from viable continuity to breakdown.

parent_channels.name: Measure, Fitness, and Selection

subchannels.name: Equality, Standard, and Fair Middle
subchannels.scene_or_process: Two things are compared, balanced, or located against a shared standard.
subchannels.active_motifs: equality and equivalence `س و ي:B001/m01`; fair midpoint `س و ي:B006/m01`; measured ounce `و ق ي:B004/m01`; wealth calibrated to a head `س و ي:B013/m01`; diminution by taking `خ و ف:B004/m01`; small portion `ط غ و:B007/m01`; fitting equivalence `ز ك و:B004/m01`; parity in name `س م و:B005/m02`; corresponding gap `ع ق ر:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Equality can be quantitative, spatial, verbal, or nominal. Weight supplies a fixed standard, the midpoint supplies a fair position, and naming or fit supplies equivalence at the level of social and linguistic classification.

subchannels.name: Suitability, Deliberation, and Meticulous Handling
subchannels.scene_or_process: An action is slowed and refined until it suits the object, circumstance, or norm.
subchannels.active_motifs: aptitude for good `ء ر ض:B003/m01`; suitability and propriety `ز ك و:B004/m01`; deliberation and composure `ر س ل:B004/m01`; meticulous handling `ن و ق:B005/m01`; straight finished form `س و ي:B002/m01`; sustained concern `ق و ل:B015/m01`; respite and room `ن ف س:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Fitness is produced through attention rather than speed. Deliberation creates room to assess, meticulous handling adjusts the action, and a straight finished form shows that the result suits its intended condition.

subchannels.name: Choice, Pairing, and Category Shift
subchannels.scene_or_process: An item is selected or paired, while a proverb exposes a mismatch or transformation of category.
subchannels.active_motifs: careful selection `ن و ق:B006/m01`; pair or even state `ز ك و:B005/m01`; otherness and substitution `س و ي:B007/m01`; chosen designation `س م و:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Selection presupposes alternatives and a criterion of fit. Pairing confirms compatibility, otherness marks the rejected alternative, and designation fixes the chosen item within a named class.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Objects, persons, claims, or actions are compared against a standard and found equal, fitting, mature, or chosen.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; the roots occur at 91:5 `السماء`, 91:7 and 91:14 `سواها`, 91:8 `تقواها`, 91:9 `زكاها`, 91:13 `رسول` and `ناقة`, and 91:15 `عقباها`.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Abstract parity becomes concrete in an ounce, a paired game-call, a fair midpoint, meticulous handling, and selection from alternatives.

parent_channels.name: S1. Casting Lots and Gaming Implements
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Players assemble lots and implements, cast or strike them, and compete for a winning result.
parent_channels.active_motifs: gambling contest `ق م ر:B007/m01`; leather bag holding lots `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; fifth gaming arrow `ن ف س:B016/m01`; game bat `ق و ل:B008/m01`; paired game-call `ز ك و:B005/m02`; short arrow `ر س ل:B011/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The scene joins equipment, storage, chance, and rivalry. Lots or arrows are kept together, a turn selects or strikes an implement, and the resulting combination determines advantage or defeat.

parent_channels.name: S2. Naming and Proper-Name Transfer
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A descriptive word becomes a name, title, invocation, or place-name and then circulates independently of its original image.
parent_channels.active_motifs: naming and designation `س م و:B005/m01`; solar-derived names `ش م س:B007/m01`; proper names from day or river vocabulary `ن ه ر:B007/m01`; Layla as a personal name `ل ي ل:B004/m01`; divine name in invocation `ء ل ه:B002/m01`; named valley associated with falsehood `خ ي ب:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Naming detaches a lexical image from its immediate scene and fixes it to a person, place, or sacred address. Sun, day, night, valley, and divine invocation thus become sources of durable social reference.

parent_channels.name: S3. Constitution, Essence, and Logical Definition
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A thing is understood through its composed form, intrinsic identity, signification, and verbal boundary.
parent_channels.active_motifs: composed constitution `ب ن ي:B002/m01`; essence or intrinsic self `ن ف س:B012/m02`; signification `ق و ل:B014/m01`; logical definition `ق و ل:B016/m01`; otherness `س و ي:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Constitution describes how a thing is put together, essence what it is in itself, and definition how speech marks its boundary. Otherness supplies the contrast needed to distinguish that identity from substitutes.

parent_channels.name: S4. Exile, Strangerhood, and Night Travel
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A person leaves the homeland, becomes a stranger, and travels or pursues a route under reduced visibility.
parent_channels.active_motifs: expulsion or departure from homeland `ج ل و:B004/m01`; stranger as “son of the land” `ء ر ض:B004/m01`; extended wandering `ط ح و:B002/m01`; night travel and activity `ل ي ل:B002/m01`; moonlit approach `ق م ر:B003/m02`; easy traveling gait `ر س ل:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Departure breaks the relation between person and homeland, producing strangerhood as a social state. Night and moonlight shape the journey’s visibility, while gait and pursuit give the displaced traveler a directed path through unfamiliar ground.

parent_channels.name: S5. Supposition, Modality, and Otherness
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A proposition is framed as uncertain, directed toward an alternative, or contrasted with what is other.
parent_channels.active_motifs: saying used as supposition `ق و ل:B011/m01`; particle of qualification or possibility `ر ب ب:B015/m01`; otherness and substitution `س و ي:B007/m01`; directed reference `س و ي:B008/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Modality changes how a statement relates to reality without changing its subject. Qualification lowers certainty, otherness opens an alternative, and directed reference locates the proposition relative to a distinct object or belief.

parent_channels.name: S6. Predawn and Forenoon Meals
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Eating and drinking are organized around the predawn and forenoon intervals.
parent_channels.active_motifs: predawn meal `ف ل ح:B006/m01`; forenoon meal `ض ح و:B003/m01`; current night `ل ي ل:B003/m01`; bright day interval `ن ه ر:B002/m01`; measured draught `ن ف س:B006/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: The meals are distinguished by their temporal placement. Night leads to the sustaining predawn intake, day advances toward the forenoon meal, and the draught supplies the small bodily rhythm within each eating interval.

parent_channels.name: S7. Attendance and Visitation
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A visitor approaches a person or place, enters the social field, and is received with familiarity or confrontation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: coming to a person or place `غ ش و:B003/m01` and `غ ش ي:B005/m01`; turning toward a destination `س و ي:B004/m01`; familiarity and ease with another `ر س ل:B007/m01`; exposing oneself in confrontation `ء ر ض:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Visitation begins as directed approach and becomes a social relation at arrival. Familiar reception permits ease and continued attendance, while confrontation turns the same face-to-face exposure into challenge.
